FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURES. Not Troop 32 history.

These event records, names (e.g. "Jordan Q.", "Mr. Example"), places, and
placeholder images are invented to exercise the Events pages in fixture mode:

  npm run dev:fixtures | build:fixtures | preview:fixtures | test:pages

They are loaded only when TROOP32_EVENT_FIXTURES=1 (set by
scripts/fixtures.mjs), build into dist-fixtures/, and never reach dist/.
The images are artificial graphics, not photographs. Never add a real Scout,
real photo, or real event here. Expected results assume "today" = 2027-08-15.
